dispatch.comment: Numbers of the hand-written theorem `enter` (Enter.lean): gas of the prelude, gas of one table entry, and the memory words after the prelude.

axioms.comment: names: hand-written theorems checked before the generated ones; after: theorems of files that import the generated ones; imports: the modules Test/Axioms.lean imports.

totalSupply.doc: totalSupply(): no value; returns `_totalSupply`; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

balanceOf.doc: balanceOf(a): no value, 36 bytes of call data or more; returns `_balances[a]`; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

allowance.doc: allowance(owner, spender): no value, 68 bytes of call data or more; returns `_allowances[owner][spender]`; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

decimals.doc: decimals(): no value; returns the low byte of slot 5; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

transfer.doc: transfer(to, amount) from the caller `from`. Success needs: no value, 68 bytes of call data, a frame that may write, `from` and `to` not 0, `amount <= _balances[from]`, and (when `to` is not `from`) no overflow of `_balances[to]`. Then: returns 1; `_balances[from]` is the old word minus `amount` and `_balances[to]` the old word plus `amount` (when `to = from` the balance is unchanged); `_totalSupply` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Transfer(from, to, amount).
ensures: {to} ≠ {from} → (balance message s.state {from}).toNat = (balance message state {from}).toNat - {amount}.toNat ∧ (balance message s.state {to}).toNat = (balance message state {to}).toNat + {amount}.toNat
{to} = {from} → balance message s.state {from} = balance message state {from}
totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {from} 0 → k ≠ mapSlot {to} 0 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

approve.doc: approve(spender, value) from the caller `owner`. Success needs: no value, 68 bytes of call data, a frame that may write, `owner` and `spender` not 0. Then: returns 1; `_allowances[owner][spender]` is `value`; `_totalSupply` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Approval(owner, spender, value).
ensures: totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {owner} 1) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

transferFrom.doc: transferFrom(from, to, amount) by the caller `spender`. Success needs: no value, 100 bytes of call data, a frame that may write, `from`, `to` and `spender` not 0, `amount <= _balances[from]`, `amount <= _allowances[from][spender]`, and (when `to` is not `from`) no overflow of `_balances[to]`. Then: returns 1; the balances move as in transfer (unchanged when `to = from`); `_allowances[from][spender]` is the old word minus `amount`; `_totalSupply` and every other slot keep their word; exactly two logs, Transfer(from, to, amount) then Approval(from, spender, new allowance).
ensures: {to} ≠ {from} → (balance message s.state {from}).toNat = (balance message state {from}).toNat - {amount}.toNat ∧ (balance message s.state {to}).toNat = (balance message state {to}).toNat + {amount}.toNat
{to} = {from} → balance message s.state {from} = balance message state {from}
totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {from} 0 → k ≠ mapSlot {to} 0 → k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {from} 1) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

s.substate.logs = (substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget TRANSFER {from} {to} (wordBytes {amount}))).push (log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL {from} {spender} (wordBytes (sub (allowance message state {from} {spender}) {amount})))

increaseAllowance.doc: increaseAllowance(spender, added) from the caller `owner`. Success needs: no value, 68 bytes of call data, a frame that may write, `owner` and `spender` not 0, no overflow of `_allowances[owner][spender] + added`. Then: returns 1; the allowance is the old word plus `added`; `_totalSupply` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Approval(owner, spender, new allowance).
ensures: totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {owner} 1) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k
s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL {owner} {spender} (wordBytes (add (allowance message state {owner} {spender}) {added})))

decreaseAllowance.doc: decreaseAllowance(spender, subtracted) from the caller `owner`. Success needs: no value, 68 bytes of call data, a frame that may write, `owner` and `spender` not 0, `subtracted <= _allowances[owner][spender]`. Then: returns 1; the allowance is the old word minus `subtracted`; `_totalSupply` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Approval(owner, spender, new allowance).
ensures: totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {owner} 1) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k
s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL {owner} {spender} (wordBytes (sub (allowance message state {owner} {spender}) {subtracted})))

burn.doc: burn(amount) by the caller `from`. Success needs: no value, 36 bytes of call data, a frame that may write, `from` not 0, `amount <= _totalSupply`, `amount <= _balances[from]`. Then: returns nothing; `_totalSupply` and `_balances[from]` are each the old word minus `amount`; every other slot keeps its word; exactly one log, Transfer(from, 0, amount).
ensures: ∀ k, k ≠ 2 → k ≠ mapSlot {from} 0 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

sanity.comment: The argument words of the witness call of each function (scripts/gen_sanity.py): address arguments not 0, amounts 0.
